videos.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
videos.description: In Arizona, a scientist turned miner gambles his retirement to secure a legacy for his son; against logic, Freddy and Juan must turn up the heat to fix the miner's innovative, self-designed dry washer to save the mine.

videos.description: Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

videos.description: Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above; a VIP host loses her most valuable client and puts all her hopes of making her monthly quota on a walk-in whale.

videos.description: A big music festival takes over Las Vegas and brings nearly-naked guests, packed rooms and non-stop partying to the Nugget; a disturbance call in the hotel sparks tension between guests as a desperate chip thief risks returning to the casino to cash in.

videos.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers

videos.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars

videos.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
videos.description: In Bristol County Jail, half of the cells don't lock; as changing demographics bring in more violent, gang-affiliated criminals, staff must manage a higher-risk population without the facility slipping into chaos.

videos.description: After two unclaimed cargo packages are opened, experts are called in after officers suspect that they may contain stolen ancient artifacts; when a family heading to the Middle East is found carrying more than the allowed $10,000 limit, questions arise.

videos.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
videos.description: While officers inspect a cargo shipment for illegal marijuana, an X-ray reveals some lewd contents; a character attracts officers' attention for bringing medications they suspect he intends to sell at an alternative lifestyle festival.

videos.title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
videos.description: A passenger arriving from Cairo has brought some extra carry-ons that interest officers; an American fashion designer returning from Paris fails to declare nearly $20,000 worth of luxury goods; a bag of snails from West Africa raises suspicions.
